body:
Founder real-time, justified frustration at being asked to manually diagnose staleness instead of the script guaranteeing it itself: 'either it should be updated or not handle it... you didnt rig up the entrypoint it should always be the colab skrip.' Real gap: _bootstrap_repo used git pull --ff-only, which silently no-ops if the local checkout ever diverged -- no loud error, just stays stale indefinitely across cell restarts in the same runtime. Fixed: git fetch + git reset --hard origin/main unconditionally forces the real latest commit every run, and the resulting commit hash now prints as normal output automatically every time, no separate command needed. Live-verified: reset a real local clone 5 commits behind, ran the new logic, confirmed it force-updated correctly. BRAWLPIT commit 15e6d9d.

⚓ ☃
title: S438: colab_train.py now force-updates to the real latest commit every run
